description: Allows an emergency runtime override only when it is time-bounded, independently approved, auditable, and accompanied by a named incident record.
expression: context.request.stage == 'OVERRIDE' && context.override.emergency == true && context.override.reason != '' && context.override.expires_at_epoch_seconds > context.now_epoch_seconds && context.override.requested_by != context.override.approved_by && context.approval.status == 'APPROVED' && context.approval.quorum_met && context.evidence.override_ticket != '' && context.evidence.audit_event_id != ''
